entries.reason: Extend the exact October4 review scope to the independent native style collector and comparison. Preserve the earlier PNG review, existing owner index and all upstream lineage.

Expose independently decoded style catalogs with native GUIDs, observed values and explicit incomplete coverage. Compare only unique kind/name pairs, retaining ambiguous matches, mixed-font differences and missing fields. Three focused tests and a real CDD comparison cover 56 style pairs, 114 positions and 17 retained differences; this is not complete plugin-free acceptance.
